insights: IMF GFSR: 22% of global banking assets in weak banks under AI-crash + bond-yield spike stress (up from 18%), Asian banks hardest hit excluding China.

Japan regional deposit flow: Tohoku banks (Procrea Holdings, Bank of Iwate, Akita Bank) start merger talks for ¥13.3tn group by 2028 amid rate-driven deposit competition and demographics; BOJ Sept deposits +1.6% y/y.
Inequality gap: Japan relative child poverty ~11%, single-parent rates high; AI wealth concentration fuels UBI/abundance debates (Musk: beyond UBI to high income era).
Ethics (insolvency): Stress scenarios highlight insolvency risks for weaker SIFIs and regionals; ethical need for redistribution and UBI-dignity to protect against deposit shifts and AI shocks.
Heal: Regional consolidation builds scale and resilience; pair with targeted UBI/cash transfers to heal inequality and buffer job/automation risks.

news.title: IMF stress test: AI boom fuels more weak banks in doomsday scenario
news.summary: IMF Global Financial Stability Report (Oct 2026): under AI crash + soaring yields + slowdown, 22% of global banking assets in 110 weak lenders (core capital <7%), up from 18%. Asian banks (ex-China) most affected.

news.title: UBI discussions intensify amid AI abundance visions and inequality
news.summary: Elon Musk on AI enabling high-income era beyond UBI; NYT and others highlight pilot programs for AI job risks. Japan analyses note UBI alone insufficient without capital/redistribution paths; relative poverty persists.
